criteria.name: CSE Handover & Service Continuity
criteria.implemented: Actual local observation/policy/action/ACK/recovery during stopped central IN-CSE; explicit reconnect/expired-intent/replay behavior.
criteria.verified_captured: Recorded 14.635-second central outage with fixed serving MN-CSEs; matching historical source plus accepted bounded delta and final-source boundary tests.
criteria.absent: No serving-CSE transition, target-CSE state/subscription/ACP rebuild or automatic handover.
criteria.disposition: Reviewed deferral remains appropriate for fixed facilities; no handover level or score is assigned.
criteria.simpler_alternative: Keep local facility authority and durable state through the tested central outage.
criteria.reopen: Justified gateway maintenance/failure requires a different serving CSE; then test identity mapping, state/subscriptions/ACP restoration, interruption/loss and any claimed automatic trigger.

criteria.name: oneM2M–MEC Application / VM Deployment
criteria.implemented: Pinned actual ACME processes and AE registrations, including two MN-CSEs and an IN-CSE, with reproducible local deployment instructions.
criteria.verified_captured: Local deployment and native registration/routing evidence exists; public MEC endpoint readiness was investigated.
criteria.absent: No authenticated permitted MEC host, managed image deployment/hosting logs or orchestration across eligible MEC hosts.
criteria.disposition: The MEC extension deferral is accepted. Actual local AE/CSE deployment must be described accurately; this review does not infer official proficiency solely from the missing or local hosting mode.
criteria.simpler_alternative: Project-local pinned processes without Docker satisfy the prototype's tested deployment need.
criteria.reopen: A permitted project host, image-deployment right and registration/logging endpoints become available.

criteria.name: Federated Learning (TR-0084)
criteria.implemented: Profile-bound deterministic diagnosis and actual model inference are separate implemented paths.
criteria.verified_captured: No FL participant training, aggregation or ESTIMED VM execution evidence exists.
criteria.absent: A justified learning task/dataset, actual multi-client training/coordination and rubric-specific ESTIMED VM use.
criteria.disposition: Reviewed deferral accepted; actual LLM inference is not FL and earns no FL implementation claim.
criteria.simpler_alternative: Interpretable configured rules cover the current synthetic cases.
criteria.reopen: Measurable cross-site learning/data-locality need and ESTIMED VM path exist; test actual aggregation and applicable dynamic participation/resilient rounds.

criteria.name: Geolocation Services
criteria.verified_captured: No actual network/MEC/oneM2M location-service interworking is captured.
criteria.absent: Location-service events mapped into a location-dependent application behavior.
criteria.disposition: Reviewed deferral accepted. Static facility identity and the 3D layout are not location-service evidence.
criteria.simpler_alternative: Fixed zone configuration supplies the operating scope.
criteria.reopen: Moving equipment/responders need genuine service events that change policy, placement or handover.

criteria.name: MEC Services
criteria.implemented: Native oneM2M discovery and a shared MCP/service interface.
criteria.verified_captured: No actual non-location MEC service is consumed through oneM2M. MEC033 is a candidate, not an available tested service.
criteria.absent: Supported service instance, oneM2M/IPE resource mapping and application use of actual MEC responses.
criteria.disposition: Reviewed deferral accepted; MCP and native CSE discovery are not MEC service consumption.
criteria.simpler_alternative: oneM2M discovery covers current facility equipment needs.
criteria.reopen: A supported useful non-location service is available and a oneM2M -> IPE -> actual MEC -> CSE/application result can be observed.
